dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000rdnq](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000rdnq) Magnitude 5.5 earthquake at 60.551 depth occurred on Sep 29 2025 113km E of Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 52.9856 longitude 159.6626. It impacted 210 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
